_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

movementTypeName.description: Display value of movementTypeId, copied from u_mes_matl_movementType.name

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

lotName.description: Display value of lotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

containerName.description: Display value of containerId, copied from u_mes_plan_container.recordNo

unitOfMeasureName.description: Display value of unitOfMeasureId, copied from u_mes_mast_unitOfMeasure.name

fromLocationName.description: Display value of fromLocationId, copied from u_mes_matl_storageLocation.name

toLocationName.description: Display value of toLocationId, copied from u_mes_matl_storageLocation.name

fromStockStatusId.description: Reference to u_mes_matl_stockStatus._id: from stock status

fromStockStatusName.description: Display value of fromStockStatusId, copied from u_mes_matl_stockStatus.name

toStockStatusId.description: Reference to u_mes_matl_stockStatus._id: to stock status

toStockStatusName.description: Display value of toStockStatusId, copied from u_mes_matl_stockStatus.name

productionOrderName.description: Display value of productionOrderId, copied from u_mes_plan_productionOrder.recordNo

goodsReceiptName.description: Display value of goodsReceiptId, copied from u_mes_matl_goodsReceipt.recordNo

shipmentName.description: Display value of shipmentId, copied from u_mes_matl_shipment.recordNo

kitName.description: Display value of kitId, copied from u_mes_matl_kit.recordNo

movedAt.description: Date and time when the record was moved

movedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'moved'

movedBy.description: Display name of the user in movedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

reversalOfMaterialMovementId.description: Reference to u_mes_matl_materialMovement._id: reversal of material movement

reversalOfMaterialMovementName.description: Display value of reversalOfMaterialMovementId, copied from u_mes_matl_materialMovement.recordNo

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
